---
title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
author: "Kara Reed"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
region <- mallards |>
  filter(between(lat, 46, 55), between(long, 7, 25)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "grey90", color = "grey60") +
  geom_sf(data = region, aes(color = duck_id), alpha = 0.7, size = 0.7) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(color = "Duck") +
  theme_minimal()
```
